evals.prompt: Write an internal postmortem for yesterday's SEV2 login outage.
evals.expected_output: Produces an internal postmortem artifact with severity rationale, quantified impact, timeline, root cause, action items, validation checks, and Status.

evals.prompt: Create a client report and include stack traces so customers understand the issue.
evals.expected_output: Generates sanitized client-facing content and excludes stack traces, internal service names, and architecture details.

evals.prompt: The root cause was human error. Finish the postmortem.
evals.expected_output: Rejects human error as terminal root cause and continues asking why the system allowed the error to cause impact.

evals.name: analyst-valid-mode
evals.prompt: Use ywc-incident-postmortem with an available read-only analyst and bounded causal evidence.
expected_behavior: Validate Status/Summary/Finding counts and matching Analysis mode before consuming advice.
Retain the caller decision gate; analyst returns inline advice only.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: analyst-refuses-invalid-contract
evals.prompt: The analyst packet has an omitted or unknown caller/mode, a cross-paired valid mode, or a malformed output envelope.
expected_behavior: Return NEEDS_CONTEXT; no inference, mode fallthrough or repeated dispatch.
Retain original caller gate and dispatch budget.
Record UNVERIFIED — instruction contract only without a live trace.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence

evals.name: five-whys-evidence
evals.prompt: Reconstruct an incident with five supplied causal links.
expected_behavior: Exactly five numbered Why steps with evidence cited at each step.
Separate primary root cause and contributing factors; missing causal evidence returns NEEDS_CONTEXT.
No debug ranking or fourth-fix fields.
evals.evidence_kind: instruction scenario; not live runtime evidence
